action.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 300 ruby -e '
require "bcrypt"
require "active_record"
require "action_view"
require "devise"
require "devise/orm/active_record"
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "postgresql", host: "localhost", database: "consul_development")
u = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute("select id, encrypted_password from users where email='\''admin@consul.dev'\''").to_a[0]
puts "bcrypt match admin: " + BCrypt::Password.new(u[0]) == "Aa12345678".to_s
' 2>&1 | tail -3
